purpose: Protect verified progress from silent rewind, destructive redesign, or uncheckpointed changes to critical NayaPOWER execution surfaces.

baseline.meaning: Checkpoint the verified protected Smart Board and canonical Cloudflare release-lane changes before allowing the next protected execution lane to continue.

protected_scope.rule: Changes to critical execution architecture require verification and a fresh checkpoint before the next protected change is accepted.

anti_rewind.rule: Current main HEAD must be a descendant of the checkpoint baseline. A rewind, force-push behind the baseline, or replacement history that loses the protected baseline fails closed.

checkpoint_protocol.step_1: Make the smallest necessary protected change.
checkpoint_protocol.step_2: Run the relevant tests and verification evidence.
checkpoint_protocol.step_3: If protected paths changed, create a new checkpoint whose baseline commit is the verified protected-change commit before another protected change is accepted.
checkpoint_protocol.step_4: Never advance a checkpoint merely because code exists. Verification evidence is required.
checkpoint_protocol.step_5: If evidence is unavailable, preserve UNKNOWN/BLOCKED and do not promote the checkpoint.
checkpoint_protocol.step_6: A cold Naya restores the checkpoint before modifying protected scope.

known_risks: The canonical Cloudflare release lane has not yet produced live runtime proof.
The Assistant Cloudflare/live production lane remains a separate runtime proof boundary and must not be substituted with the GitHub source checkpoint.
GitHub server-side branch protection/rulesets are not currently configured; this gate remains a CI enforcement layer.
unknowns: Whether the canonical release workflow will execute successfully after checkpoint advancement.
Whether the resulting HTML will propagate to the supplied Cloudflare runtime.
Final desktop/mobile Chromium browser proof remains pending.
next_action: Rerun the Protected Progress Gate against checkpoint baseline 891e77b69686a55421bedf84281702dfbcf46a18, then allow the canonical Cloudflare release lane to run and verify the exact live runtime and browser acceptance.
truth_rules: A newer commit is not automatically a better state
No checkpoint may erase or rewrite historical evidence
failure_behavior: FAIL CLOSED. Identify the first divergence, preserve the evidence, and leave one executable repair action.
